title: Fresh Off The Dock
description: A brand-new shipment hasn't gone anywhere or hit any snags yet — the ledger should reflect that plainly the instant it's created.
successCondition: POST /api/booking to create a shipment. The 201 response doesn't surface status/approved directly, so confirm via `npm run db:psql`: the new shipments row has status = 'booked' and approved = true, both without your request ever mentioning either field.
hints: ShipmentStatus defaults to "booked" and approved defaults to true at the Prisma schema level (prisma/schema.prisma) — POST /api/booking's body never accepts either field.
select status, approved from shipments where id = '<id>'; is enough to check both defaults at once.
